function finishMatch(){matchActive=false;document.getElementById('playButton').disabled=true;let us=table.find(r=>r.t.us),op=table.find(r=>r.t===opponent());us.j++;op.j++;us.gf+=score[0];us.gs+=score[1];op.gf+=score[1];op.gs+=score[0];let gd=score[0]-score[1];us.gd=us.gf-us.gs;op.gd=op.gf-op.gs;if(gd>0){us.p+=3;us.v++;op.d++;us.form.push('V');op.form.push('D');document.getElementById('commentary').textContent='Vitória do Verde FC!'}else if(gd<0){op.p+=3;op.v++;us.d++;us.form.push('D');op.form.push('V');document.getElementById('commentary').textContent='Derrota apertada.'}else{us.p++;op.p++;us.e++;op.e++;us.form.push('E');op.form.push('E');document.getElementById('commentary').textContent='Empate no tempo normal.'}toast('Fim de jogo — '+score[0]+' × '+score[1]);round++;if(round>38&&['A','B','C'].includes(currentDivision)){finishSeason()}else render();document.getElementById('playButton').textContent='PRÓXIMA PARTIDA';document.getElementById('playButton').disabled=false;document.getElementById('playButton').onclick=()=>{matchActive=false;initPitch();document.getElementById('playButton').textContent='JOGAR 15 MIN';document.getElementById('playButton').onclick=advanceMatch}}
function finishSeason(){let rows=[...table].sort((a,b)=>b.p-a.p||b.v-a.v||b.gd-a.gd||b.gf-a.gf);let pos=rows.findIndex(r=>r.t.us)+1;if(pos<=4&&currentDivision!=='A'){let dest={D:'C',C:'B',B:'A'}[currentDivision];toast('Acesso confirmado! Verde FC sobe à '+divisions[dest].name);currentDivision=dest}else if(pos>=17&&currentDivision!=='D'){let dest={A:'B',B:'C',C:'D'}[currentDivision];toast('Verde FC caiu para '+divisions[dest].name);currentDivision=dest}else{toast(pos===1?'CAMPEÃO DA COMPETIÇÃO!':'Temporada encerrada em '+pos+'º lugar')}season++;round=1;let teams=divisions[currentDivision].teams;table=teams.map((t,i)=>({t,p:0,j:0,v:0,e:0,d:0,gf:0,gs:0,gd:0,form:[]}));render()}
